description: Clean SDK implementation — sdks/ foundation (spec + Rust SDK). Delete crates/stitchd-sdk; create sdks/spec/ (docs, proto, openapi, schemas, fixtures) as language-agnostic contract; create sdks/rust/ server-side SDK on stitchd-core with polling-based definition sync, LRU list-segment cache (lazy-on-miss + hybrid refresh), batched event flush. All SDK traffic via gateway (sole trust boundary for SDK key); backend services trust gateway-propagated env_id metadata.
